questions.question: Find the mode and the median of the goals: 12, 15, 9, 15, 18, 11, 15, 10, 14.
questions.expected_answer: In order the scores are 9, 10, 11, 12, 14, 15, 15, 15, 18. The mode is 15, because it appears three times. The median is the fifth value, 14.

questions.question: Find the median of the marks 12, 14, 15, 17, 18 and 19.
questions.expected_answer: There are 6 marks, so there are two middle values, 15 and 17. The median is halfway between them, which is 16.

questions.question: Write one sentence that summarises the team's goals and one prediction.
questions.expected_answer: The team scored between 9 and 18 goals, and its usual score was about 14 or 15. In the next match it will probably score about 14 or 15 goals.
